query:
When the family sorted contributions for the January gathering, everyone agreed to bring something. What did one person's initial response reveal about their actual relationship to the food-bringing expectation, and what specifically in how they responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Nkem
B. Emeka
C. Bisi
D. Kayode
context:
[1] (about=Adaeze, core, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Insists everyone brings a dish; drinks not enough.
[2] (about=GROUP, said_by=Adaeze, group-interaction, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Final confirmation: gathering on January 25th at Tolu and Funke's, 3pm, with assigned dishes.
[3] (about=Auntie Grace, said_by=Seun, profile, t14 @2025-02-24T19:02:00) Seun says Auntie Grace's solo trip is the most important announcement of the year; she deserves it more than anyone.
[4] (about=Auntie Grace, core, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Will make moin moin on the day; advises Kayode to eat properly before arriving.
[5] (about=Bisi, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:41:00) omg yes SEUN's jollof 🙌🙌🙌 what do I bring
[6] (about=Emeka, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:56:00) Good rice is good rice. E.
[7] (about=Funke, episodic, t2 @2025-01-13T18:50:00) Adaeze I know you feel strongly about everyone contributing a dish - and you are absolutely right - but maybe Kayode can bring drinks AND the puff puff? That way we are covered 😂
[8] (about=Kayode, core, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Offers to bring drinks; later agrees to bring puff puff from Peckham.
[9] (about=Nkem, core, t10 @2025-02-10T18:02:00) Nkem would like to learn to make one Adaeze dish properly before Christmas.
[10] (about=Nkem, said_by=Auntie Grace, profile, t8 @2025-02-03T19:32:00) Auntie Grace says it is completely natural; the Oyelaran gatherings are a lot even for people who have been coming for thirty years.
[11] (about=Nkem, core, t8 @2025-02-03T19:32:00) Nkem asks if Valentine's Day is typically a family occasion or a separate thing.
[12] (about=Seun, core, t0 @2025-01-06T19:00:00, [earlier-state]) Believes 2025 will be different; had peaceful Christmas; prefers plant-based diet but slipped due to mother's pepper soup.
[13] (about=Seun, core, t3 @2025-01-20T20:00:00) Believes 2025 will be different; had peaceful Christmas; prefers plant-based diet but slips; now fully committed to veganism after excellent blood test results.
[14] (about=Tolu, core, t8 @2025-02-03T19:32:00) Tolu says restaurant reservations made in October for February 14th are the only responsible choice.
[15] (about=Tolu, core, t14 @2025-02-24T19:02:00) Tolu notes Adaeze's recipe adaptation is a significant data point for family dinner planning.
[16] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t12 @2025-02-17T20:23:00) TOLU I see the reasoning. A unified gathering has its merits. I will attend regardless. Regards, D.A.O.
agent_answer:
D. Kayode

Kayode’s initial response was to offer to bring **drinks** — which revealed that he treated drinks as a sufficient contribution to the January gathering. That ran against the actual expectation, because **Adaeze** insisted that everyone bring a **dish** and that drinks alone were not enough. **Funke** then picked up on this and suggested Kayode could bring **drinks AND the puff puff** so the family was covered. Kayode later agreed to bring puff puff from Peckham, showing the adjustment.

query:
The family had their regular Sunday video call. What did one family member's participation reveal about their actual relationship to the call — and what in Adaeze's account of the call makes that visible?

Options:
A. Kayode
B. Bisi
C. Emeka
D. Nkem
context:
[1] (about=Adaeze, episodic, t7 @2025-02-03T19:30:00) Good evening my children. Kayode, you have been on every call this month. I notice these things. God willing this continues.
[2] (about=Auntie Grace, episodic, t6 @2025-01-27T17:41:00) My dear Emeka, please listen to Tolu. I see too many patients who push through when they should be resting 🙏 a missed Sunday is fine, just rest
[3] (about=Kayode, said_by=Tolu, profile, t8 @2025-02-03T19:32:00) Tolu notes consistency is the only thing the family chat requires.
[4] (about=Nkem, core, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Thinks missing church is natural after a full day; asks if Sunday call happened.
[5] (about=Seun, episodic, t8 @2025-02-03T19:57:00) Nkem I love that you said that honestly I mean you are allowed to find it a lot, no one expects you to perform being fine with ten people in one room
[6] (about=Tolu, episodic, t14 @2025-02-24T19:50:00) Just to note, this is a significant data point for family dinner planning going forward.
[7] (about=Uncle Dele, episodic, t12 @2025-02-17T20:05:00) ADAEZE correct. Christmas is at the family home. No variations required. Best regards, Dele
agent_answer:
A. **Kayode**

Kayode’s participation revealed that he is consistently present on the Sunday video calls. This is made visible in **Adaeze’s account** when she says:

> “Kayode, you have been on every call this month. I notice these things. God willing this continues.”

So Adaeze’s observation directly shows Kayode’s actual relationship to the call: he shows up every time.
